title: ursinia pusilla
intro: Ursinia pusilla, commonly known as the Small Daisies or Dwarf Ursinia, is a plant species in the daisy family. It is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Ursinia pusilla include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help in treating wounds and infections. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including sesquiterpenes and flavonoids, which have been found to exhibit antioxidant and antiseptic properties.
